svg.title: proofreader_evolve at a glance
svg.desc: Visual overview of the proofreader_evolve loop. Frozen inputs on the left: two TRAIN brains (794495 auxiliary, 802449 selection), three development-validation brains hidden from the agent, frozen detectors producing fixed candidate pools with K = 2000 per kind, and a context cache of fragment neighbourhoods plus level-1 and level-0 image patches for the top 20,000 candidates per brain and kind. The generation loop in the middle: the host allocates the kind (pending follow-up, floor, recent gain, headroom) and the starting branch (a newly promoted reference first, otherwise the champion for tuning or an alternative for exploration); the agent revises scorer, training and descriptor code from TRAIN feedback; the host measures on TRAIN with fold refits, pool-scale descriptors and paired ablations; the submission is scored by frozen inference on the hidden brains; the promotion gate requires the equal-brain mean Precision@K gain to clear paired-bootstrap noise; the TRAIN archive keeps up to five branches per kind for behavioural diversity: the champion, specialists that recover positives others miss, near-best alternatives with different Top-K sets or formulas, and the protected accepted reference; one branch is the starting point of each generation. Outputs on the right: best_scorer.py with model artifacts and descriptors.json, ledger and report, and per-kind validation curves (merge and split) of run precision_20261005_114814. The bottom band states what the agent never sees.
svg.text: A fresh agent session rewrites one scorer component per generation; the host measures, scores hidden brains and promotes only gains that beat resampling noise.
feedback, fitting rows and the official selection score
Development-validation brains · hidden from the agent
equal-brain mean of merge/split Precision@K decides promotion
queried every generation: development data, not a final test
fitted on 794495 · K = 2000 per kind · never retrained
Context cache · top 20,000 per brain & kind
raw inputs only, built once; nothing here is a feature
ONE GENERATION · repeated; early stop per kind

g.text: champion to tune, alternative to explore
no result returns to the agent
mean P@K gain beyond bootstrap noise?
no → keep parent, retain the branch

svg.text: diverse in behaviour, not code text
TRAIN feedback → agent · fitting rows → host measurements
dots = generations that edited that kind
green = promoted (hollow: gain within noise) · amber = rejected
The agent sees TRAIN feedback, tool results and cached contexts. It never sees labels, ground truth, absolute coordinates, persistent IDs or any validation result.
The host alone holds labels and validation pools, computes the selection and bootstrap statistics, allocates kinds and writes the records. Generated code runs in seccomp/Landlock-sandboxed workers.
